name: sandbox-tuner
description: Explains each Claude Code sandbox block in plain words and turns recurring blocks into reviewed, one-press, undoable edits of your user settings.

minimumSightings.title: Sightings before Allow
minimumSightings.description: How many times a host or write folder must recur before Sandbox Tuner offers Allow.

linkCheckMinutes.title: Minutes between link checks
linkCheckMinutes.description: How often an interactive session checks again for links into the folders that Allow opened. 0 turns the timed check off.
